routeBodyDemand.note: A fully-packed board is the worst case; normal play holds far fewer settled cells.

value.note: Pre-swap baseline. These are the fixtures the chosen backend must satisfy; per WS-4.3 each is still classified contract vs implementation-characterization before migration, so a green count here is a starting point and not a licence to freeze old-solver semantics.

fairestCaseRapierFraming.reason: rapier wasm/glue not resolvable from node_modules

bundleConsequence.rule: §B.1 scenario 3 must stay within 1.5x the measured Three.js equivalent. The budget is derived from that measurement and cannot be raised (R2).
bundleConsequence.comparatorAlsoUsesCannon: tools/bundle-scenarios/entries/scenario-3-threejs.ts imports cannon-es, so the denominator does not grow when Aura3D adopts a heavier backend.

divergences.contractConsequence: `setCcdEnabled` means two different things; identical user code yields different physical outcomes.

divergences.cannon: absent — cannon-es ships no character controller; Aura3D hand-wrote CharacterController.ts
divergences.rapier: KinematicCharacterController constructed and removed; disposed=true; slopes, steps, snap-to-ground and autostep API present
divergences.contractConsequence: A contract-level character controller is either hand-written for one backend or delegated for the other — not one implementation.

divergences.cannon: none — no documented transferable/SAB path; state lives in JS objects
divergences.rapier: WASM linear memory is transferable/SAB-compatible; documented worker usage
divergences.contractConsequence: Worker stepping cannot be a contract feature if one backend cannot cross a thread boundary.

abstractionVerdict.verdict: A backend abstraction is NOT free: 3 measured dimensions diverge, and each one must be either hidden (losing capability) or exposed (losing neutrality). Shipping both also sums the bundles. Recommend ONE production backend plus an explicitly non-physical arcade-motion mode, which is not a physics backend and must not be described as one.

optionalTopologyVerdict.topology: Physical simulation is an explicitly installed, asynchronously initialized optional package. Core, product, and authored-unit arcade bundles import no rigid-body engine.
optionalTopologyVerdict.selected: @dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0 as an asynchronously loaded optional chunk; the non-compat raw-WASM entry requires unsupported consumer-specific Vite configuration
optionalTopologyVerdict.rationale: Rapier is current, supplies native CCD plus character and vehicle controllers, supports the required worker topology, is materially more stable, and measures 0.295/1.266/4.081 ms per step at 220/1000/5000 bodies versus Cannon's 1.651/12.782/402.291 ms. Its larger payload is isolated from non-physical bundles rather than used to reject the stronger solver.
optionalTopologyVerdict.semver: Major unless the async initialization and physical-result migration are proven source- and behavior-compatible.

rule: R1 — every value below is produced by constructing and stepping the candidate world. Unmeasurable dimensions are reported as `unmeasured` with a reason and are not scored.

backends.label: cannon-es (incumbent)

value.mitigation: adaptive substeps sized so no body advances more than half the thinnest static extent per substep

characterController.reason: cannon-es ships no character controller; Aura3D hand-wrote CharacterController.ts

vehicleController.value: RaycastVehicle constructed, one wheel stepped, engine force applied, and removed; wheels=1

workerSupport.reason: no documented transferable/SAB path; state lives in JS objects

notes: `ccdSpeedThreshold` is NOT a property of cannon-es 0.20.0 Body (verified: `"ccdSpeedThreshold" in new Body()` === false). Setting it is inert, so the raw-step tunnelling result is a real library limitation, not a harness misconfiguration.
Adaptive substeps recover it: the same 400 m/s body is stopped by the wrapper Aura3D already ships in apps/common/src/cannon-physics-proof.ts.
cannon-es exports RaycastVehicle; Aura3D does not use it and hand-wrote 1,081 lines instead.
Pure JS: no WASM init, no worker-transferable state, single-threaded.

backends.label: Rapier (@dimforge/rapier3d-compat)

value.mitigation: none required — setCcdEnabled(true) is native swept CCD; reported unchanged so the two backends are compared on the same field

characterController.value: KinematicCharacterController constructed and removed; disposed=true; slopes, steps, snap-to-ground and autostep API present

vehicleController.value: DynamicRayCastVehicleController constructed, one wheel stepped, and removed; wheels=1; raycast suspension, engine/brake force and steering API present

workerSupport.value: WASM linear memory is transferable/SAB-compatible; documented worker usage

notes: Rust/WASM: cross-platform bit-identical stepping is a designed property, not incidental.
Ships KinematicCharacterController=true, DynamicRayCastVehicleController=true — the two subsystems Aura3D hand-wrote.
